findings: Direct timeout validation compares only historical established birth and discards retired authority. A NOT_SPAWNED sentinel record accepts a timeout after the same PID and birth were reaped, with no later direct wait.
Adopted signal-error expiration accepts an equal-time adopted reap because its retirement filters consider only strictly earlier events and its expiration join does not otherwise revoke authority.
The review archive ran Python 3.8.19 rather than packet 19's required Python 3.8.10 and omitted interpreter version output.
